name: Passkey Authentication
summary: Source-level implementation evidence for email-bound passkey authentication across browser and mobile clients.

sourceReferences.note: Email-bound begin, browser-complete, and token-complete endpoints are exposed.
Email resolves the durable user and delegates to the user-bound passkey proof with user verification required.
Angular uses the retained email with generated email-bound begin/complete operations and the browser WebAuthn ceremony.
React Native performs the native passkey ceremony and completes through the generated email-bound token operation.
Generated contracts expose typed email-bound begin, browser complete, and mobile token complete operations.

runtimeEvidence.note: Implementation is source-ready. Browser/device runtime execution has not yet been performed.
